info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Rideshare Rides Status-v1-spec
info.description: The Rideshare Rides Status API enables businesses to query the current status of rideshare rides efficiently. By utilizing this endpoint, developers can retrieve real-time information about the status of multiple rides, facilitating enhanced tracking and management. Common use cases include fleet management, customer service applications, and analytics for rideshare providers. This API is designed to support developers looking to integrate rideshare status information into their applications seamlessly.

get.summary: Retrieve the status of a ride.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to check the current status of a specified ride, providing real-time updates on its progress, such as whether it is in progress, completed, or canceled.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the status of rides. It includes the necessary parameters and options to filter the results based on specific criteria.

200.description: The current status of rides has been retrieved successfully.

ListRideshareRidesStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to ride statuses. It is expected to be a string indicating the status of the rides.

ListRideshareRidesStatusResponse_200.title: Ride Status Response

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number associated with the ride request.

resultId.description: The identifier for the result of the ride status check.

state.description: The current state of the ride.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the response.

ListRideshareRidesStatusResponse_200.description: This schema represents the response for the Ride Status GET operation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The user who created the ride status record.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the ride status record was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was automated.

AuditInfo.description: This schema contains audit information related to the ride status.

x-processing-time.description: The amount of time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request.
